integrity: Self-contained analytic derivation and runnable finite sanity checker; no external human or independent certification is asserted. The self-review is limited to the displayed assumptions.
scientific_limitations: Two-level one-spike real Euclidean spectrum, nonorthogonal nonoptimal start, exact Haar tangent sampling and exact reduced Rayleigh-Ritz; finite/noisy/approximate operator queries and nonspiked spectra not covered. Equal forward applications do not imply equal runtime, storage, or reduced eigenproblem cost. Existing literature already describes line and multi-vector algorithms. Publication priority not independently checked.
title: Exact finite-budget laws for adjoint-free stochastic Rayleigh–Ritz search on one-spike spectra
